payload.title: Add persistent background Render Queue with immutable scene snapshots
acceptance: Queue freezes selected scene, media references and export settings at enqueue; later edits cannot affect output.
Durable queue exposes pending/running/completed/failed status and job settings with cancellation/retry.
Rendering runs independently of active editor so playback/editing remain available.
Canonical runtime owns queue state/actions; tests cover snapshot isolation and queue lifecycle.
Build, deploy and verify short background render while editing a separate live scene.
